algorithm: occupied and unknown inflation by footprint plus grid margin
safe 8-connected traversal with diagonal corner-cut rejection
frontier detection separated from dead-end classification
deterministic cycle anchor when no natural node exists
canonical uint64-compatible node and edge identities

negative_cases: diagonal blocked corners do not connect
inflation blocks cells inside the configured footprint radius
frontier is not mislabeled as dead-end
closed pure cycle receives one deterministic anchor
parallel corridors retain distinct edge IDs
edge endpoints are canonical and traced polylines are reversed when needed
invalid grids and versions are rejected

verification.target_command: Set-Location hsl_core; python -m pytest tests/test_topology.py tests/test_topology_extraction.py -q

limitations: The extractor uses a deterministic grid graph rather than a production medial-axis skeletonizer; its connectivity convention is explicit and testable.
Portal insertion at local clearance minima and junction-region clustering beyond cell-level events remain follow-up refinements.
Swept footprint and turnability require P3.5 path validation; edge clearance is not by itself a motion certificate.
ROS 2 serialization and physical G2 route acceptance remain unavailable on this Windows host.
